"Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1875 by F.W. Beer & Co. in the Office of the Librarian of Congress at Washington D.C." Includes business directories, distance table, subscribers business notices, Montcalm County diagram, insets of Gowan, Greenville, Coral, Sheridan, Howard City, Stanton, Carson City, Langston, Deans Mills, East part of Stanton City, and Crystal. LC copy imperfect: Mounted on cloth backing, original sheets sectioned into 8 panels to enable folding.
